{{Quote|He's probably calling it an outrage, [and] thinks that the Skyway Flyer company has a long history of anti-Neimoidian sentiment, and has evidence that the transit company is horning in on Trade Federation markets.|Senator Orn Free Taa, joking about Dod's speeder accident|<ref name="HNN 54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_3.html|Senator Taa Apologizes Over Dod "Joke"}}</ref>}}
An '''anti-Neimoidian sentiment''' was dislike or prejudice against the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] skyway accident, [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] made a joke about the accident on the ''[[Amberdawn]]'' morning show, presuming that Dod was going to file a lawsuit against [[Skyways Flyer]] for allegedly having a long history of anti-Neimoidian sentiment; although Taa later apologized, Dod was still offended by the joke.<ref name="HNN 54" />
